dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's the same as always, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Yes. she doesn't like to work and hides away to take naps all the time. She said that she'll grow taller this way...

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Sayu has an aptitude for ninjutsu, so she's very elusive. She can even be a bigger headache than Heizou...

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: I really hope I can find her soon. Then I'll have some time to ask Lady Yae for the latest novels...
